desc: Derive and prove an efficient fixed-\(k\) DP handling forward-only character changes, deletions, and insertions.
Optimize across all candidate common frequencies in \(O(26n)\), suitable for \(n \le 2\cdot10^4\).
Handle empty output, absent letters, zero-frequency targets, the `'z'` boundary, and edge cases.
Implement `Solution.makeStringGood(self, s: str)` and validate it against the provided examples and small-case reasoning.
